name: 02745 · New Bedford, MA
findings: ZIP 02745 (New Bedford) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02745 (New Bedford) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02745 (New Bedford) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 29% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
